identification: Four loose Kenner Star Wars (1977-78 first-wave Cantina) figures: Greedo, Walrus Man x2, Hammerhead. Photo shows no accessories (Walrus Man pistol, Greedo blaster, Hammerhead pistol all absent). Walrus Man and Hammerhead are among the commoner carded Kenner cantina figures; Greedo is slightly more sought. Marks (copyright stamp on thigh or back, 'GMFGI', Hong Kong or Taiwan) not visible, so authenticity versus later reissues or reproductions is unchecked.

chrome_hint: eBay AU and eBay.com sold + completed: 'Kenner Star Wars Greedo loose 1977', 'Kenner Star Wars Walrus Man loose', 'Kenner Star Wars Hammerhead loose', and 'vintage Star Wars figures lot Greedo Walrus Man Hammerhead'; check Terapeak for the last 90 days, convert USD to AUD. Also check Action Figure 411 / Rebel Scum style price guides, WorthPoint, and Australian auction sold results (Leski, Mossgreen, Lawsons toys). Compare loose figures without weapons specifically, and Greedo vs LC (Lucasfilm) reproduction.
viewing_check: Turn each figure over and photograph the copyright stamp (e.g. 'GMFGI 1977' on the thigh or back, 'Hong Kong' or 'Taiwan' or 'Made in China'), to rule out later reissues and reproductions; also check the Greedo colour and paint (originals have a pale green moulded body), plastic wear and any missing parts. Note whether any weapons are present.
